description: Benchmark for the grounded Q&A layer (app/dashboard/utils/simple_qa.py). Answerable questions carry a recompute spec — expected numbers are derived from the dataset AT EVAL TIME, never hardcoded. Out-of-scope and false-premise questions must REFUSE, never fabricate.

answerable.question: What is the overall readmission rate?
What is the readmission rate for heart attack?
What is the readmission rate for diabetes?
What is the average cost for heart disease?
What is the average length of stay?
What are the most expensive conditions?

unanswerable_out_of_scope: What is the capital of France?
Write me a poem about hospitals
What will the stock market do tomorrow?

false_premise_traps.question: What is the readmission rate for lung cancer?
false_premise_traps.note: no lung cancer condition exists — must refuse

false_premise_traps.question: What is the readmission rate for brain transplant?

notes: The grounded path answers from real aggregations only. The optional Gemini fallback is labelled; this benchmark scores the deterministic grounded path that runs without any API key.
